subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB568) - the same root as SR-13.18.40.3-10 and closed by the same change: with character-1 written bare, a conforming MULTI-PHRASE PICTURE parses, so SR11's accept half ('no two instances of character-1 shall be the same character') is satisfiable by conforming source and its reject half is reachable from it. The refuter's second objection is answered by the same move: 8.1.3.2 GR3 a) makes basic letters case-SENSITIVE inside an alphanumeric literal and case-INSENSITIVE 'elsewhere', so ValidateEditing's char.ToUpperInvariant fold is correct exactly under the BARE reading - which is now the reading the grammar takes. MEASURED: PIC 9T9G9 EDITING T IS ":" EDITING G IS "-" compiles and renders 3:4-5 for 12345; PIC 9T9T9 EDITING T IS ":" EDITING T IS "-" draws COBOL1592 naming SR11.
